name: future-radio-streamer
description: Headless YouTube RTMP Streamer for Future Radio

scripts.start: rm -f /tmp/.X99-lock && rm -rf /run/pulse /var/lib/pulse /root/.config/pulse && pulseaudio -D --system --disallow-exit --disallow-module-loading || true && xvfb-run --server-args="-screen 0 1920x1080x24" node stream.js
